paragraphs.text: The British Library catalogues an 1874 albumen print of the canal workshops at Jobra among the John Beames papers. Its description identifies a general workshop view and leaves the photographer unknown. That record locates a historical photograph; it does not, by itself, identify the workers or explain how a working day unfolded.
The catalogue supplies a dated archival reference for Jobra, not proof of its foundation date.
